install: curl -fsSL -o /tmp/starship.tar.gz "https://github.com/starship/starship/releases/download/v$INGLENOOK_VERSION/starship-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz" && echo '10c8eb4cb3b761d9bf59ea828444c2dab36c900b7d69a69e08814b286969df89  /tmp/starship.tar.gz' | sha256sum -c - && tar -xzf /tmp/starship.tar.gz -C /usr/local/bin starship && rm /tmp/starship.tar.gz
stage: if [ "$INGLENOOK_VARIANT" = day ]; then t=10:30; else t=21:30; fi; sed -i "s/^time_format = .*/time_format = \"$t\"/" ~/.config/inglenook/starship.toml
